## Rule

**Projection task (ARC-GEN d687bc17):**
- Grid has 4 border colors: edgecolors = [top, right, bottom, left]
- Interior pixels have colors from 4 edge classes or garbage (garbage != any edge color)
- Top/bottom edge cells are placed at rows [2..H-3], cols [2..W-3] (sampled unique columns)
- Left/right edge cells are placed at rows [2..H-3] (unique rows), cols [2..W-3]
- Output: keep border, project interior edge-color cells to their matching side:
  - top_color cell at (r,c) -> output[1][c] = top_color
  - bottom_color cell at (r,c) -> output[H-2][c] = bottom_color
  - left_color cell at (r,c) -> output[r][1] = left_color
  - right_color cell at (r,c) -> output[r][W-2] = right_color
- Garbage cells: disappear (not in output)

## Algorithm sketch

```
color20 = argmax(input_onehot) via dilated Conv  # [1,1,20,20] argmax
interior = (0 < row < H-1) AND (0 < col < W-1)
interior_color = where(interior, color20, sentinel10)  # mask border cells
source_color = interior_color[2..H-2, 2..W-2]  # 16x16 source window

top_color = color20[row0, col1]  # first col of row 0
bottom_color = color20[row1, last_row]  # dynamic bottom row
left_color = color20[row1, col0]
right_color = color20[first_row_of_col1, last_col]

# For each edge: find per-column/row max matching cells
top_hit_line = pad(ReduceMax(where(source==top_color, top_color, 0), axis=row), 2+2)
# merge with border values at col0 and colW-1
top_line_update = max(top_hit_line, canvas_border[row1, :])
# same for bottom, left, right

canvas = where(interior, 0, color20)  # border-only canvas
canvas = ScatterElements(canvas, [row1, rowH-2], [top_update, bottom_update])
canvas = ScatterElements(canvas, [col1, colW-2], [left_update, right_update])
canvas30 = pad(canvas20, sentinel10, to 30x30)
output = Equal(canvas30, color_ids_u8[0..9])  # BOOL one-hot
```

## Floor proof (2026-06-30, v3 @ 7718)

Cost model is **sum of ALL intermediate tensors + params** (the graph output `[1,10,30,30]`
BOOL = 9000B is FREE — verified: full static sum 17420 − 9000 output = 8420 = scored memory).
So every named node output counts; minimize count × size, not peak.

v3 per-tensor breakdown (memory 7524, params 194):

| Component | Bytes | Why it cannot be removed |
|---|---:|---|
| `color_f32` [1,1,20,20] F32 | 1,600 | Conv-argmax (Σ k·onehot_k). Conv output dtype follows F32 input. Alternatives re-measured: ArgMax→INT64 [1,1,30,30]=7,200; Cast whole input→F16=18,000; cropping input to 16×16 first = F32 [1,10,16,16]=10,240. All worse. Interior-only Conv can't shrink it without one of those. |
| `canvas30` [1,1,30,30] U8 | 900 | Pad(canvas20)→30×30 then Equal vs color_ids. Pad-then-Equal(900) < Equal-then-Pad ([1,10,20,20] BOOL = 4,000). Output must be 30×30 to byte-match LIVE. |
| 4× `*_diff` [1,1,16,16] U8 | 1,024 | One arithmetic membership plane per edge color. 4 colors FORCED: 58,526 corpus cases share a top+bottom source column and 61,151 share a left+right row, so a single max-reduce loses a color (don't-do log). Single plane/color is the v3 minimum (was 2/color in v1). |
| 3 canvas copies (`canvas_border`,`canvas_rows`,`canvas20`) [1,1,20,20] U8 | 1,200 | base (border-only) + after row scatter + after col scatter. Row/col projections are on different axes ⇒ 2 ScatterElements minimum. ScatterND-merge rejected: 4D index ≈ 2,560B ≫ the 400B saved. |
| `color20` [1,1,20,20] U8 | 400 | Cast(color_f32→U8). The U8 workhorse for every border/interior/source op. |
| `interior` [1,1,20,20] BOOL | 400 | `row_inside AND col_inside`; the [20×20] condition for the two Wheres below. row/col 1-D masks can't drive Where without the AND'd plane. |
| `interior_color` [1,1,20,20] U8 | 400 | `Where(interior, color20, 10)`. Sentinel-masks border cells that fall inside the fixed [2..18,2..18] source window for grids W<20/H<20 (e.g. right border col W-1=14 for W=15). Slicing color20 directly = visible 7/266 (don't-do). Slicing-then-masking on 16×16 = 768B > 656B current. |
| `source_color` [1,1,16,16] U8 | 256 | Shared 16×16 source window, one Sub operand for all 4 diffs. Reducing over the full 20×20 instead (to drop this) grows each diff 256→400 (+576) — net +320, worse. |
| INT32 scatter indices (`row_indices` 160, `col_indices` 160, `right_index`/`bottom_index` 80 each) | 480 | ScatterElements index must match update shape and be INT32/INT64; INT32 is the floor. |
| F16 count chain + BOOL inside masks + tiny lines | ~860 | F16 ReduceSum is min dtype for counting (U8/INT ReduceSum unscoreable). Dynamic H,W derivation + per-line pad/base/update tensors. |
| Params: conv_w(40) + idx/shape/pad consts | 194 | Already minimal (+2 vs v1 for the opset-14 `sum_axes` ReduceSum input). |

**Total ≈ 7,718. This is the new architectural floor.**

**Why v3's single plane is safe**: UINT8 `Sub(source,color)` == 0 exactly when `source==color`;
`ReduceMin==0` over the axis ⇔ that column/row contains the color. Empty interior cells hold
color 0 (background) and masked border cells hold sentinel 10 — edge colors are always 1..9, so
neither aliases a match. Behaviour is byte-identical to v1's `Where(Equal,color,0)→ReduceMax`
(verified AB 200266/200266, divergences=0). Requires opset 14 (U8 Sub/ReduceMin have no kernel below 14).

**Max merges are NOT redundant** (carried from v1, v2's drop is broken): `canvas_border[row1,col0]=left_color`
and `[row1,colW-1]=right_color` are non-interior cells; the row ScatterElements writes the whole row,
so without `Max(hit_line, line_base)` those border corners are zeroed. Same for bottom/left/right.

**Remaining lever / WALL**: The two biggest items (`color_f32` 1,600 and `canvas30` 900 = 32% of cost)
are both forced by dtype rules (Conv→F32; 30×30 U8 output to match LIVE). No reformulation found that
beats them without a larger F32/INT64 intermediate. Absent a new ORT dtype capability (e.g. a scoreable
U8/F16 Conv-argmax, or BOOL-reduce), **7,718 is a WALL.**

- 2026-06-01 crop-risk probe: the paired-scatter v1 architecture at 14x17 now scores 5,570 and passes train/test, but still fails `ng_gate visible` at 83/266 because the local ARC-GEN/visible corpus includes larger 20x20 cases. This is not a Path A-safe route.
- 2026-06-01 QLinear/ConvInteger entry probe: blocked for this architecture because the scorer input is F32 one-hot; quantizing/casting the full `[1,10,30,30]` input to UINT8 costs 9,000 bytes before any win.
- 2026-06-01 bitset membership probe: `BitwiseAnd` checker passes at opset 18/19/20 but `score_network_v2` returns `None`, matching the Onnx_Advanced warning that bitwise handlers are not scoreable here.
- Do not collapse top/bottom or left/right membership by reducing colors first: in the cached 200k ARC-GEN corpus, 58,526 cases have top+bottom edge-color markers sharing a source column and 61,151 have left+right sharing a source row.
- 2026-06-01 source-from-`color20` shortcut: slicing the fixed 16x16 source window directly from `color20` saved 400 bytes but failed visible 7/266 because smaller grids put dynamic bottom/right border colors inside that fixed window; keep the `interior_color` sentinel mask.
- 2026-06-01 sparse `TopK` rewrite probe: `TopK(UINT8)` is not implemented in local ORT; F32 `Reshape(20x20)->TopK(K=15)` alone scores 1,720 bytes (flat buffer + INT64 indices), before source masking/scatter assembly, so it does not currently look like a sub-5k path.
- 2026-06-01 narrower sparse `TopK` recheck: F32 `Reshape(16x16)->TopK(K=15)` scores 1,084 if the source is already F32; the real v1 source is UINT8, so a Cast adds 1,024 bytes before coordinate decode and scatter updates. Still not a sub-5k route.
- 2026-06-01 F16 `TopK` recheck: ORT loads `TopK(F16)`, but `score_network_v2` returns `None`, so it is not usable as a low-byte sparse selector here.
- 2026-06-01 `MaxPool` hit-line shortcut: replacing `ReduceMax(16)->Pad(20)` with one padded `MaxPool` would save 64 bytes, but ORT rejects padding 2 on the non-pooled dimension when kernel width/height is 1 (`Pad should be smaller than kernel`). Keep `ReduceMax` + `Pad`.
- 2026-06-01 `ScatterElements(reduction="max")` probe: opset 16/18 checker accepts the attribute, but `score_network_v2` returns `None` on a UINT8 probe. Keep explicit `GatherElements` line-base + `Max`, and use paired scatters only in the scoreable opset-12 form.
- 2026-06-01 BOOL/UINT8 reductions recheck: `ReduceMax(BOOL)` and `ReduceSum(UINT8/INT32/INT64)` scorer probes return `None`. The hit-line path still needs `Where(match, color, 0)` before `ReduceMax`, and row/col counts still need the F16 `ReduceSum` route.
- 2026-06-01 fixed-size 14x17 risk probe: deleting variable-size handling plus complete static-endpoint projected lines drops the official-test-size candidate to 4,946, but it only matches the single 14x17 official test case and scores visible 2/266, truth 15/2000. It is not a useful exact path; keep it in experimental only.

- 2026-06-24 Do NOT try to eliminate the 4 Max operations on line_bases: canvas_border at col 0 and col W-1 of projection rows carries left/right border colors (non-interior cells), and Max is required to merge these with the hit lines. Removing Max breaks border at projection rows.
